activeEvents.title: August Trails Day at Cape Henlopen

activeEvents.title: Historic Lewes Farmers Market

reviewNotes: Editorial window July 31–Aug 12, 2026. Replaced the previous generic 'Bandstand season, in full swing' placeholder with five specific, source-verified events (Rehoboth Bandstand x2, Bethany Bandstand, Cape Henlopen Trails Day, Lewes Farmers Market) plus three further-out picks (Rehoboth Bandstand x2, the Dewey ZAP Pro/Am skimboarding championship). Kept the list intentionally smaller than every bandstand night available this period — Rehoboth alone has six shows in the window; only the ones that felt genuinely worth a special trip made the cut, consistent with editorial voice rather than a raw listings dump. Fenwick Island had nothing visitor-facing in-window (only routine town-committee meetings) — correctly left out rather than padded. Sea Witch Festival (Oct 23-25) untouched, still valid. Both remaining Coming Soon guides reviewed and refreshed; no new material found for either this cycle.
